name: Denver
tagline: Mile High City at the foot of the Rockies
summary: Denver is a sunny, outdoorsy city a mile above sea level, with the Rockies on the horizon. See a concert at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, explore Union Station and the craft breweries of RiNo, then head into the mountains for Rocky Mountain National Park, Boulder or ski towns.
seasonNote: Summer for hiking and Red Rocks concerts; winter for skiing nearby.
arrival: Denver International is 37 minutes from Union Station by A Line train.
gettingAround: Light rail, buses and a car for the mountains.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Green chile, bison burgers and craft beer.
buyTip: Outdoor gear at REI flagship and Western wear.
